Bienvenidos

A sunny home in the heart of Málaga

The Lights is three houses with one warm welcome: a lively boutique hostel, hotel-style suites and a 100-year-old Andalusian house with its own garden.

Step out of the door into the Mercado Central, wander through the old town to the cathedral and Calle Larios, and keep going until you reach the sand. Come back for breakfast, a cold sangría on the terrace and one of our free themed dinners.

Summer in Málaga

Sun, sea & the city

Leave the car at home. From our door, Málaga's best summer days are all within walking distance: the beach, a seafront promenade, rooftop views and long tapas evenings.

  • Muelle Uno & the port≈ 12 min walk
  • La Malagueta beach≈ 20 min walk
  • Pedregalejo & El Palo beachesShort bus ride
  • Sunset at the Gibralfaro≈ 25 min walk

The neighbourhood

The best address in town

We're right in Málaga's historic centre, so the city's highlights are a short walk from our door.

  • 1min

    Mercado Central de Atarazanas

    Fresh fish, fruit and tapas bars, right next door

  • 5min

    Calle Larios

    Málaga's elegant shopping street

  • 8min

    The Cathedral

    "La Manquita" and the old town squares

  • 10min

    Museo Picasso & Alcazaba

    Art, Moorish palaces and a Roman theatre

  • 20min

    La Malagueta beach

    Sun loungers, chiringuitos and espetos
